title: Controllers: the controller you pick up drives the Arisen (dev13, PS5 + Xbox)
intro: Both controllers connected (PS5 wired, Xbox wireless), co-op OFF, playing the Arisen, somewhere open with no enemies. DPC 0.9.170-dev13b (Reset Scripts first). This test switches the game's active controller. Press End (keyboard) when ready.

steps.text: Get ready: both controllers in reach. Press End to start.
PS5: walk forward with the left stick.
Put the PS5 down. XBOX: walk forward with its left stick. Does the Arisen walk (maybe after a moment)?
XBOX: jump with A a few times.
Put the Xbox down. PS5: walk forward again. Back on the PS5?
Keyboard: W for a moment, then the PS5 stick again. Still fine?
Done. Tell Claude which steps worked.

probes.pads:
local o = {}
local function ax(v) if not v then return "-" end local ok, s = pcall(function() return string.format("%.2f,%.2f", v.x, v.y) end) return ok and s or "?" end
pcall(function()
  local inp = sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.CharacterManager"):call("get_ManualPlayer"):call("get_Input")
  o[#o + 1] = "arisenL=" .. ax(inp:call("get_AxisL"))
end)
pcall(function()
  local m = sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.UserPadManager")
  local d = m:call("get_ActiveUserPad"):call("getDevice")
  o[#o + 1] = string.format("active=%X %s", d:get_address() & 0xFFFFFF, d:get_type_definition():get_name())
end)
pcall(function()
  local gp = sdk.get_native_singleton("via.hid.GamePad"); local td = sdk.find_type_definition("via.hid.GamePad")
  local arr = sdk.call_native_func(gp, td, "get_ConnectingDevices")
  for i = 0, arr:call("get_Count") - 1 do
    local dv = arr:call("get_Item", i)
    o[#o + 1] = string.format("d%d[%X] b=%X L=%s", i, dv:get_address() & 0xFFFFFF, dv:call("get_Button") or 0, ax(dv:call("get_AxisL")))
  end
end)
local R = _G.DPC_dbg and _G.DPC_dbg.R
if R then o[#o + 1] = "switches=" .. tostring(R.tp.pa_n or 0) .. " err=" .. tostring(R.tp.pa_err) end
return table.concat(o, " ")
